$comment: Reserved CESARD implementation markers: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_NUMBER = -99999; NOT_IMPLEMENTED_TEXT = 'TBD'. These values denote mandatory metadata whose derivation is not yet implemented and are distinct from null/None.

AxisAccuracy.description: Bias and standard deviation along one horizontal axis.

bias.description: Estimated systematic component (bias) of the absolute localisation error along this coordinate axis, in metres.

standard_deviation.description: Estimated standard deviation of the absolute localisation error along this coordinate axis, in metres.

AxisAccuracy.title: AxisAccuracy

BackscatterMetadata.description: Backscatter measurement representation and multilooking metadata.

measurement.description: Backscatter coefficient represented by the measurement assets, for example sigma nought (sigma0) or gamma nought (gamma0).
measurement.title: Measurement

convention.description: Numerical convention used to encode backscatter measurements; 'linear power' stores backscatter intensity on a linear scale.
convention.title: Convention

conversion_equation.description: Equation used to convert linear backscatter values (DN) to logarithmic decibel values.
conversion_equation.title: Conversion Equation

range_number_of_looks.description: Number of statistically combined looks in the range direction for the generated product.
range_number_of_looks.title: Range Number Of Looks

azimuth_number_of_looks.description: Number of statistically combined looks in the azimuth direction for the generated product.
azimuth_number_of_looks.title: Azimuth Number Of Looks

equivalent_number_of_looks.description: Equivalent Number of Looks (ENL), describing the effective number of independent looks represented by the product.

BackscatterMetadata.title: BackscatterMetadata

Card4lMetadata.description: Reference to the applicable CARD4L product-family specification.

specification.description: Short identifier of the CEOS Analysis Ready Data product family specification implemented by the product.
specification.title: Specification

version.description: Version of the implemented CEOS CARD4L product family specification.

document.description: URL or DOI referencing the implemented CEOS CARD4L Radar Backscatter product family specification.

Card4lMetadata.title: Card4lMetadata

CommonMetadata.description: Metadata shared by the ARD product and all contributing source scenes.

antenna_look_direction.description: Side of the satellite ground track illuminated by the SAR antenna, expressed as LEFT or RIGHT relative to flight direction.
antenna_look_direction.title: Antenna Look Direction

constellation.description: Name of the satellite constellation to which the platform belongs, where applicable.

instrument_short_name.description: Short name of the SAR instrument that acquired the source data.

operational_mode.description: Instrument acquisition mode used to collect the source data.

orbit_direction.description: Direction of the platform ground track during acquisition: ascending or descending.
orbit_direction.title: Orbit Direction

orbit_mean_altitude.description: Mean platform altitude during the acquisition, in metres.
orbit_mean_altitude.title: Orbit Mean Altitude

orbit_number_absolute.description: Absolute orbit number of the acquisition.
orbit_number_absolute.title: Orbit Number Absolute

orbit_number_relative.description: Relative orbit or track number of the acquisition.
orbit_number_relative.title: Orbit Number Relative

platform_full_name.description: Full name of the satellite platform.

platform_identifier.description: Platform serial identifier distinguishing a specific satellite within a mission or constellation.

platform_reference.description: Reference to the CEOS Missions, Instruments and Measurements database record describing the satellite mission.

platform_short_name.description: Short mission or platform name used by the source metadata convention.

polarizations.description: Transmit/receive polarization channels contained in the acquisition, such as HH, HV, VH or VV.
polarizations.title: Polarizations

polarization_mode.description: Polarization acquisition mode describing the channel configuration of the SAR acquisition.

processing_level.description: Processing level assigned to the source data used to generate the ARD product.
processing_level.title: Processing Level

radar_band.description: Common name of the radar frequency band used by the instrument, such as X, C or L band.
radar_band.title: Radar Band

radar_center_frequency.description: Radar centre frequency of the instrument, in hertz.
radar_center_frequency.title: Radar Center Frequency

sensor_type.description: Type of remote-sensing instrument; RADAR for the SAR products represented by this model.
sensor_type.title: Sensor Type

swath_identifier.description: Identifier of the acquisition swath or beam.

wrs_longitude_grid.description: Longitude-grid identifier of the reference system used to locate the acquisition, equivalent to a track-like identifier.
wrs_longitude_grid.title: Wrs Longitude Grid

CommonMetadata.title: CommonMetadata

CompressionMetadata.description: Compression configuration used for product raster assets.

type.description: Compression algorithm or codec applied to product raster assets.

z_errors.description: Maximum permitted compression error for applicable assets, represented as a mapping from asset identifier to MAX_Z_ERROR. A value of 0 denotes lossless LERC compression.
z_errors.title: Z Errors

CompressionMetadata.title: CompressionMetadata

DEMMetadata.description: Digital elevation model and Earth gravitational model metadata.

name.description: Human-readable name of the digital elevation or surface model used for geometric and radiometric terrain processing.

type.description: Type of terrain-height model used during processing: an elevation model representing terrain height or a surface model including surface objects.
type.title: Type

reference.description: URL, DOI or other persistent reference identifying the digital elevation or surface model used for terrain correction.

access.description: Location from which the digital elevation or surface model used for processing can be accessed.

gsd.description: Native ground sampling distance of the digital elevation or surface model used during processing.

resampling_method.description: Resampling method used to prepare the digital elevation or surface model for geometric and radiometric processing.

egm_reference.description: URL, DOI or other persistent reference identifying the Earth Gravitational Model used to relate elevation-model heights to the required vertical reference.

egm_resampling_method.description: Resampling method used when preparing the Earth Gravitational Model for processing.

DEMMetadata.title: DEMMetadata

type.description: Coordinate frame in which geometric accuracy is reported: 'gtc' uses northern/eastern axes for the geocoded terrain-corrected product, whereas 'slant-range' uses line/sample directions of the radar geometry.
type.title: Type

eastern.description: Absolute localisation error statistics for the eastern axis when type='gtc', or the sample/range axis when type='slant-range'.

northern.description: Absolute localisation error statistics for the northern axis when type='gtc', or the line/azimuth axis when type='slant-range'.

radial_rmse.description: Radial root mean square error (rRMSE) summarising the horizontal absolute localisation error of the output product, in metres.

reference.description: URL or DOI referencing documentation or calibration/validation results used to derive the absolute localisation accuracy estimate.

GeometricCorrectionMetadata.description: Geometric correction algorithm and resulting accuracy.

algorithm.description: URL or DOI referencing the algorithm or technical documentation used for geometric terrain correction and geolocation.

resampling_method.description: Resampling method used when geometrically correcting and resampling the source measurements to the output grid.

accuracy.description: Estimated absolute localisation accuracy of the geometrically corrected output product.

GeometricCorrectionMetadata.title: GeometricCorrectionMetadata

GeometryMetadata.description: Spatial footprint metadata in EPSG:4326 and, optionally, native CRS.

bbox.description: WGS 84 bounding box of the footprint as (west, south, east, north), in longitude and latitude degrees. For footprints crossing the antimeridian, west may be greater than east.
bbox.title: Bbox

bbox_native.description: Bounding box of the product footprint in the product's native coordinate reference system, ordered as (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax).
bbox_native.title: Bbox Native

geometry.description: Acquisition footprint as a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon in WGS 84 (EPSG:4326). GeoJSON coordinates are ordered as longitude, latitude pairs; polygon rings are closed.
geometry.title: Geometry

GeometryMetadata.title: GeometryMetadata

GridMetadata.description: Raster grid, CRS and MGRS metadata for the ARD product.

epsg.description: EPSG code of the native coordinate reference system used by the ARD product grid.
epsg.title: Epsg

wkt.description: Well-Known Text representation of the native coordinate reference system used by the ARD product grid.

rows.description: Number of raster rows (lines) in the default product grid.
rows.title: Rows

columns.description: Number of raster columns (pixels per line) in the default product grid.
columns.title: Columns

pixel_spacing_row.description: Sampling distance between adjacent raster rows in the native coordinate reference system.
pixel_spacing_row.title: Pixel Spacing Row

pixel_spacing_column.description: Sampling distance between adjacent raster columns in the native coordinate reference system.
pixel_spacing_column.title: Pixel Spacing Column

transform.description: Affine transformation coefficients mapping pixel coordinates of the default raster grid to coordinates in the native CRS.
transform.title: Transform

mgrs_id.description: Military Grid Reference System (MGRS) tile identifier of the product. The identifier combines UTM zone, latitude band and 100 km grid square.

pixel_coordinate_convention.description: Location within a raster pixel to which the grid coordinates refer; this model currently uses the upper-left pixel corner.
pixel_coordinate_convention.title: Pixel Coordinate Convention

number_of_border_pixels.description: Number of no-data border pixels surrounding a backscatter measurement raster, if present.
number_of_border_pixels.title: Number Of Border Pixels

definition_reference.description: URL or other persistent reference describing the grid or tiling-system definition used for the product.

convention_reference.description: Description, URL or DOI identifying the gridding convention used to align products to a consistent sampling frame.

GridMetadata.title: GridMetadata

GroundSamplingDistance.description: Ground sampling distance with an explicit unit.

value.description: Ground sampling distance of the elevation model in the unit given by 'unit'.
value.title: Value

unit.description: Unit in which the elevation-model ground sampling distance is expressed: metres or arc-seconds.
unit.title: Unit

GroundSamplingDistance.title: GroundSamplingDistance

IncidenceAngleMetadata.description: Near-, mid- and far-range incidence angles in degrees.

minimum.description: Near-range incidence angle of the source acquisition, in degrees.
minimum.title: Minimum

maximum.description: Far-range incidence angle of the source acquisition, in degrees.
maximum.title: Maximum

mid_swath.description: Incidence angle at the centre of the source swath, in degrees.
mid_swath.title: Mid Swath

IncidenceAngleMetadata.title: IncidenceAngleMetadata

applied.description: Whether noise removal was applied during processing of the backscatter measurements.
applied.title: Applied

algorithm.description: URL or DOI referencing the noise-removal algorithm when noise removal was applied; otherwise None.

PerformanceEstimate.description: Minimum, mean and maximum noise-equivalent intensity estimate.

minimum.description: Minimum noise-equivalent backscatter intensity level for the corresponding polarization, in decibels.
minimum.title: Minimum

mean.description: Mean noise-equivalent backscatter intensity level for the corresponding polarization, in decibels.
mean.title: Mean

maximum.description: Maximum noise-equivalent backscatter intensity level for the corresponding polarization, in decibels.
maximum.title: Maximum

PerformanceEstimate.title: PerformanceEstimate

ProcessingMetadata.description: Information about the processor that created a product or source scene.

facility.description: Name or code of the facility that processed the source data or generated the ARD product.

date.description: UTC date and time at which the source data or ARD product was processed.
date.title: Date

mode.description: Processing mode describing whether the processing configuration is nominal operational processing or a prototype.
mode.title: Mode

processor.description: Name of the primary processor software used to generate the data.

software.description: Software used during processing, represented as a mapping from software name to version.
software.title: Software

ProcessingMetadata.title: ProcessingMetadata

ProductMetadata.description: Metadata describing the generated ARD product.

name.description: Human-readable name of the implemented CEOS CARD4L Radar Backscatter product family.
name.title: Name

product_type.description: Short CARD4L product-family identifier: NRB for Normalised Radar Backscatter or ORB for Ocean Radar Backscatter.
product_type.title: Product Type

acquisition_type.description: High-level classification of the acquisition as nominal data, calibration data or another acquisition type.
acquisition_type.title: Acquisition Type

status.description: Lifecycle or availability status assigned to the ARD product.
status.title: Status

access.description: URL or other location from which the ARD product can be retrieved.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier assigned to the ARD product, if available.

license.description: License or copyright identifier governing use and redistribution of the ARD product.

time_start.description: UTC start time of the earliest source acquisition contributing to the ARD product.
time_start.title: Time Start

time_stop.description: UTC end time of the latest source acquisition contributing to the ARD product.
time_stop.title: Time Stop

time_created.description: UTC date and time at which the ARD product was generated.
time_created.title: Time Created

geometry.description: Spatial footprint and bounding-box metadata of the generated ARD product.

grid.description: Dimensions, sampling, georeferencing, CRS and grid-convention metadata of the ARD product raster.

processing.description: Facility, software, processing date and processing mode used to generate the ARD product.

card4l.description: Identification and reference of the CEOS CARD4L product family specification implemented by this product.

compression.description: Compression method and associated error thresholds used for product raster assets.

dem.description: Digital elevation/surface model and Earth Gravitational Model metadata used for geometric and radiometric terrain processing.

backscatter.description: Definition of the backscatter quantity, numerical convention, dB conversion and effective multilooking of the product.

geometric_correction.description: Algorithm, resampling method and absolute localisation accuracy associated with geometric terrain correction.

radiometric_accuracy.description: Absolute and relative accuracy estimates for the radiometrically terrain-corrected backscatter measurements.

noise_removal.description: Whether noise removal was applied and, when applicable, the algorithm reference.

rtc_algorithm.description: URL or DOI referencing the radiometric terrain correction algorithm or its technical implementation documentation.

number_of_acquisitions.description: Number of source acquisitions contributing to the generated ARD product.
number_of_acquisitions.title: Number Of Acquisitions

speckle_filter_applied.description: Speckle-filter configuration if filtering was applied; None indicates that no speckle filter was applied.

ellipsoidal_height.description: Ellipsoidal height, in metres, used when deriving ellipsoidal incidence-angle information, if applicable.

wind_normalization.description: Parameters defining the reference model and conditions used for wind normalization of ocean radar backscatter, if applicable.

ProductMetadata.title: ProductMetadata

absolute.description: Estimated absolute radiometric accuracy of the terrain-corrected backscatter measurements, in decibels.

relative.description: Estimated relative radiometric accuracy of the terrain-corrected backscatter measurements, in decibels.

reference.description: URL or DOI referencing documentation that describes the radiometric accuracy or uncertainty estimate and its traceability.

SourceMetadata.description: Metadata describing one source product contributing to the ARD product.

filename.description: Identifier or filename of the source data product, without a file extension.

product_type.description: Product type or processing level of the source SAR data.

data_geometry.description: Radar geometry of the source image: slant-range or ground-range.
data_geometry.title: Data Geometry

acquisition_type.description: High-level classification of the source acquisition as nominal data, calibration data or another acquisition type.
acquisition_type.title: Acquisition Type

status.description: Lifecycle or availability status assigned to the source product.
status.title: Status

access.description: URL, DOI or other location from which the source data product can be retrieved.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier assigned to the source data product, if available.

time_start.description: UTC start time of the source-data acquisition.
time_start.title: Time Start

time_stop.description: UTC end time of the source-data acquisition.
time_stop.title: Time Stop

geometry.description: WGS 84 footprint and bounding-box metadata of the source acquisition.

processing.description: Facility, software, processing date and processing mode associated with the source product.

orbit.description: Orbit timing, source and state-vector metadata used for processing the source acquisition.

swaths.description: Identifiers of the swaths or beams represented by the source acquisition.
swaths.title: Swaths

azimuth.description: Look bandwidth, number of looks, pixel spacing and resolution along the azimuth direction, keyed by swath or beam.

range.description: Look bandwidth, number of looks, pixel spacing and resolution along the range direction, keyed by swath or beam.

incidence_angle.description: Near-range, centre-swath and far-range incidence angles of the source acquisition.

instrument_azimuth_angle.description: Mean platform heading or instrument azimuth angle during acquisition, in degrees clockwise from north.
instrument_azimuth_angle.title: Instrument Azimuth Angle

lut_applied.description: Name or identifier of the lookup table (LUT) applied during source-data processing, if applicable.

sensor_calibration.description: Reference to sensor calibration parameters used for the source data, for example a URL, DOI or calibration-coefficient source.

polarimetric_calibration_matrices.description: Reference or representation of the complex-valued polarimetric distortion matrices describing channel imbalance and cross-talk corrections.

faraday_mean_rotation_angle.description: Mean Faraday rotation angle estimated from the polarimetric source data or a model, in degrees.

faraday_rotation_reference.description: URL, DOI or other reference to the method or publication used to derive the mean Faraday rotation estimate.

ionosphere_indicator.description: Whether ionospheric effects are significant enough to exceed the radiometric calibration requirement or goal for the backscatter imagery.
ionosphere_indicator.title: Ionosphere Indicator

performance.description: Noise-equivalent intensity and other SAR performance indicators reported for the source product.

SourceMetadata.title: SourceMetadata

SourceOrbitMetadata.description: Orbit metadata specific to an input source scene.

ascending_node_date.description: UTC date and time at which the platform crossed the ascending node for the orbit containing the acquisition.
ascending_node_date.title: Ascending Node Date

start_time_from_ascending_node.description: Elapsed time from the ascending-node crossing to acquisition start, in milliseconds.

completion_time_from_ascending_node.description: Elapsed time from the ascending-node crossing to acquisition completion, in milliseconds.

major_cycle_id.description: Mission-specific identifier of the major orbital cycle containing the acquisition.

datatake_id.description: Mission-specific identifier of the data take to which the source acquisition belongs.

data_access.description: Location from which orbit state-vector data used for processing can be accessed.

data_source.description: Classification of the orbit information used for processing, for example predicted, restituted or precise.

state_vector.description: Reference to the external orbit state-vector file used during processing, if such a file was used.

SourceOrbitMetadata.title: SourceOrbitMetadata

noise_equivalent_intensity_type.description: Backscatter convention to which the noise-equivalent intensity estimates refer, such as sigma0.
noise_equivalent_intensity_type.title: Noise Equivalent Intensity Type

estimates.description: Noise-equivalent intensity statistics for each available polarization channel.
estimates.title: Estimates

equivalent_number_of_looks.description: Equivalent Number of Looks (ENL) of the source data, describing its effective number of independent looks.

integrated_side_lobe_ratio.description: Mean Integrated Side Lobe Ratio (ISLR) of the source data, in decibels.
integrated_side_lobe_ratio.title: Integrated Side Lobe Ratio

peak_side_lobe_ratio.description: Mean Peak Side Lobe Ratio (PSLR) of the source data, in decibels.
peak_side_lobe_ratio.title: Peak Side Lobe Ratio

type.description: Name or type of the speckle-filtering algorithm applied to the product.
type.title: Type

window_size_col.description: Width of the speckle-filter processing window in raster columns.
window_size_col.title: Window Size Col

window_size_line.description: Height of the speckle-filter processing window in raster lines.
window_size_line.title: Window Size Line

SwathAxisMetadata.description: Sampling and resolution metadata along one SAR image axis.

look_bandwidth.description: Processing look bandwidth for this image axis, keyed by swath or beam.
look_bandwidth.title: Look Bandwidth

number_of_looks.description: Number of looks combined along this image axis, keyed by swath or beam.
number_of_looks.title: Number Of Looks

pixel_spacing.description: Sampling distance between adjacent source-data pixels along this image axis, keyed by swath or beam.
pixel_spacing.title: Pixel Spacing

resolution.description: Spatial resolution along this image axis, keyed by swath or beam; resolution describes the ability to distinguish adjacent targets.
resolution.title: Resolution

SwathAxisMetadata.title: SwathAxisMetadata

WindNormalizationMetadata.description: Optional wind-normalization metadata used by ocean radar backscatter.

backscatter_measurement.description: Backscatter measurement to which wind normalization is referenced; sigma0 for the supported ORB representation.
backscatter_measurement.title: Backscatter Measurement

backscatter_convention.description: Convention used to express the wind-normalized backscatter reference; represented as an intensity ratio.
backscatter_convention.title: Backscatter Convention

reference_direction.description: Reference wind direction used to evaluate the wind-normalization model, in degrees.
reference_direction.title: Reference Direction

reference_model.description: Reference identifying the geophysical model function or model used to derive the wind-normalized backscatter reference.

reference_speed.description: Reference wind speed used to evaluate the wind-normalization model, in metres per second.
reference_speed.title: Reference Speed

reference_type.description: Identifier of the modeled reference backscatter quantity used for wind normalization; sigma0-ref in the supported representation.
reference_type.title: Reference Type

WindNormalizationMetadata.title: WindNormalizationMetadata

description: Canonical metadata transfer object for CESARD STAC and XML writers.

schema_version.description: Version of the CESARD ARDMetadata interface schema used by this metadata object.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

common.description: Mission, platform, instrument, orbit and acquisition metadata shared by the ARD product and its contributing source scenes.

product.description: Metadata describing the generated analysis-ready radar product.

sources.description: Source SAR products contributing to the generated ARD product, keyed by a stable source identifier.
sources.title: Sources
